response:
FADE IN:

EXT. CASTLE - DAY

The camera pans over the rolling hills and lush forests of the medieval kingdom, but something is off. The once-majestic stone walls now seem dull and grey, the flags bearing the royal crest now fluttering in the wind with a faintly distorted, VHS-like quality.

CUT TO:

INT. THRONE ROOM - DAY

King ARIN, a stout and proud ruler in his mid-40s, sits upon his throne, surrounded by his advisors and courtiers. But as he gazes out at the gathered nobles, his eyes seem... distant. His expression is one of mild disinterest.

KING ARIN
(to his advisor, LORD THORNE)
I've had enough of this... this... (he waves his hand dismissively)...this "medieval" aesthetic.

LORD THORNE
Your Majesty, what do you mean?

KING ARIN
(sighing)
The grandeur, the opulence, the... (he searches for the right word)...the "knightly" flair. It's all so... passé.

LORD THORNE
But, Your Majesty, it's what our people have come to expect from a king.

KING ARIN
(shrugging)
Expect? Expect is for the common folk. I am a visionary. I see a new future, one where the boundaries between reality and... (he leans in, a conspiratorial glint in his eye)...the "digital" are blurred.

CUT TO:

EXT. CASTLE - DAY

The king's advisors and courtiers look on in confusion as the king's guards begin to dismantle the traditional stone walls, replacing them with a latticework of neon-lit, circuit-board-like structures.

KING ARIN
(to the guards)
Build me a palace of... (he searches for the right word)...of... (he snaps his fingers)...of "glitch".

GUARD 1
Yes, Your Majesty.

CUT TO:

INT. THRONE ROOM - DAY

The king's advisors and courtiers gather around a large, glowing screen, where a distorted, VHS-like video of a medieval jousting tournament plays on repeat.

KING ARIN
(to the screen)
This is the future. This is the aesthetic of the... (he leans in, a sly smile spreading across his face)...the "proto-vaporwave".

LORD THORNE
(whispering to another advisor)
I think the king has finally lost his mind.

ADVISOR 2
(whispering back)
Or perhaps he's simply ahead of his time.

CUT TO:

EXT. CASTLE - DAY

The camera pans out, revealing the castle in all its... (the king's advisors and courtiers look on in horror)...distorted, VHS-like glory. The once-majestic stone walls now seem like a relic of a bygone era, a reminder of a time when the boundaries between reality and the "digital" were still firmly in place.

FADE TO BLACK.

THE END.
